title: Snacks for the hiking club
explanation: The shape asked for a table, the units made the numbers easy to compare, and 'nothing else' removed the chatter. A person or a program could paste it straight into a notes page.
ticket: Three quick snacks for a hiking club, as a table with the columns Snack, Time to make, and Cost. Nothing before or after the table.
promptTemplate: List three quick snacks for a hiking club.{shape}{units}{only}

ingredients.label: The shape
ingredients.text: Give it as a table with three columns: Snack, Time to make, Cost.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer asked for a table. Your order never says what shape the answer takes.

ingredients.label: The units
ingredients.text: Write times in minutes, like 5 min, and costs in dollars, like $2.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants times and costs that can be compared. Your order never says which units.

ingredients.label: Nothing else
ingredients.text: Add nothing before or after the table.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants the table and nothing else. Your order never says to stop there.

outputs.base: Here are three quick snacks for a hiking club: trail mix, which you can pack in a few minutes; oat bars, which are filling; and apple slices with cheese, which are easy to carry. Let me know if you would like more ideas!
outputs.shape:
Sure! Here is a table of quick snacks:

| Snack | Time to make | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Trail mix | Quick | Cheap |
| Oat bars | A little while | Low |
| Apple and cheese | Very quick | Moderate |

Let me know if you want more ideas!
outputs.units: Trail mix takes 5 min and costs $2. Oat bars take 20 min and cost $3. Apple slices with cheese take 5 min and cost $2. All three are easy to pack. Want more ideas?
outputs.only:
Trail mix
Oat bars
Apple slices with cheese
